suite: Starweave v2 independent unified-backpack UI and storage audit
method: Unmodified production engine/storage/renderer/UI evaluated in Node VM with event-capable mock DOM, simulated timers/visibility/locks/storage and finite-checking canvas. Direct storage module tests isolate exact ownership failures.
limitations: Mock DOM does not prove native dialog focus trapping, keyboard file picker activation, accessibility tree, actual layout, overflow or canvas raster quality.
Storage event and lifecycle behavior are simulated at registered handler boundaries, not across real browser processes.
Source-only accessibility findings require live-browser verification after publication.

results.name: HTML IDs, local asset references and script order are valid
Zero-input boot advances actual engine and renderer continuously
Manual pause and resume preserve one RAF and freeze simulation
Help/settings close and native Escape leave RAF alive and resume correctly
Closing guide preserves prior explicit pause
Item dialog allows continuing auto battle and repeated upgrade transactions stay bounded
Attribute/skill eligibility and repeated delegated clicks cannot overspend
Reset Cancel, Escape and repeated Confirm are transactional
Import validation and confirmation protect current progress
Export downloads current validated save and revokes its blob URL
Visibility hide/resume saves, releases lease, loads fresh camp and never simulates hidden time
Pagehide/pageshow preserve RAF, saved progress and prevent elapsed wall-time gains
Initially background-loaded page does not claim the active writer lease
Blocked storage remains playable and retains temporary progress across visibility changes
Quota failure preserves unsaved progress when returning from background
Corrupt saved bytes are protected, exportable, and temporary progress survives hiding
Waiting tab cannot mutate and takes latest progress after ownership release
Lease theft event prevents UI transactions and keeps other-game keys untouched
Changed saved bytes after failed save protect both sessions and export live unsaved progress
Waiting duplicate-tab export never produces a fabricated fresh-session backup
Reset confirmation cannot mutate after losing tab ownership
Import confirmation cannot mutate after losing tab ownership
Newer file choice wins when older asynchronous import finishes late
Closing settings invalidates an unfinished file read
Escape from settings invalidates an unfinished file read
Reset decision invalidates an earlier pending import without stale prompts
Original damaged-save export disappears after explicit accepted recovery
Reduced motion settings take OS preference initially and survive saved settings
Keyboard-focused item action survives passive inventory/detail rerender
Import action is reachable from keyboard in source
Responsive and accessibility source safeguards exist
Unified backpack controls have no active basket, stash, retrieve, or 18-slot dependencies
V1 migration checkpoint appears as all 19 unified bag items, 2 worn items and 2 locks
Both pager control pairs show exactly 30 cards, bound the last page, and reset for a new filter
All sort choices and combined slot, upgrade, unlocked, locked filters reflect current actual items
Positive equip highlighting and detail current-to-next use full build rather than item-only power
HUD, cached highlights and open detail recompute after points, skill, bag enhancement, worn enhancement and equip
Checkbox selection survives sort, filters and pages; new arrivals never become automatically selected
Selected sale confirms exact count and value, excludes newly gained items, and never pays twice
Cancel and Escape destroy pending sale callbacks and preserve selected items
Single-item sale uses the same exact snapshot confirmation and closes obsolete details after selling
Locked and worn items are excluded, equipped selections prune, and locks revalidate before sale
Changed item enhancement price rejects an old sale rather than silently selling at a changed value
Sale loses authority immediately after lease theft and cannot overwrite another session
Hide, reload and persisted pageshow invalidate an old sale session without selling restored items
2,105-item backpack stays at 30 card nodes, caches comparisons, paginates, and exports without truncation
Import rejects over 32 MiB before reading, accepts exact 32 MiB, and independently guards oversized returned text
RAF maintains a single chain through repeated bag changes, item Escape and sale confirmation cycles
Storage lease deny/expire/release never deletes a foreign lease
Storage protect blocks ordinary writes; explicit force replacement is bounded
Storage blocked reads/writes and quota errors explicitly avoid a false saved state
Web Locks reject occupied acquisition, release ownership, and gracefully fall back
Every audited production source remained stable throughout run
